definitions.definition: Real or perceived movement of atmospheric air usually caused by convection or differences in air pressure.
definitions.example: The wind blew through her hair as she stood on the deck of the ship.

definitions.definition: Air artificially put in motion by any force or action.
To blow air through (a wind instrument or horn) to make a sound.
To cause (someone) to become breathless, as by a blow to the abdomen.
To turn coils of (something) around (something else); to wrap.
definitions.example: to wind thread on a spool

definitions.definition: To tighten the spring of a clockwork mechanism.
The act of winding or turning something.
